scope: Frozen retrospective and same-test diagnostics, not field validation

variants.baseline: Replay original frozen config at measured surface pressures
variants.test_composition: Measured WC/GOR; preserve original oil IPR exactly
variants.test_oil_inflow: Measured oil/BHP IPR anchor; original WC/GOR
variants.test_state: Measured oil/BHP anchor and WC/GOR; diagnostic only
variants.gor_minus20: Test state with GOR multiplied by 0.8; hypothetical
variants.gor_plus20: Test state with GOR multiplied by 1.2; hypothetical
variants.temp_minus20: Test state with uniform temperature reduced 20 F; hypothetical
variants.temp_plus20: Test state with uniform temperature increased 20 F; hypothetical
variants.pf_density_minus2: Test state with standard PF density reduced 2%; hypothetical
variants.pf_density_plus2: Test state with standard PF density increased 2%; hypothetical
variants.return_mesh25: Test state with 25 ft return-column grid instead of 100 ft
variants.segmented_pf: Test state with isothermal, pressure-dependent PF traverse
variants.return_no_slip: Test state with BB holdup forced to no-slip; structural probe, not a qualified correlation
variants.return_no_payne: Test state without Payne holdup correction; structural probe
